verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is an online business-entity filing and records portal. A portal of this kind could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on a user's filings, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only filing, annual reports, payments, record search and status tracking, with no mention of AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
